title: Half-step register action
statement: Given a register, a carry symbol that may be absent, states $h_F,h_T,$ and $next$, and the symbol $rd$ read from the register (or blank), the action moves the register head left and writes the carry symbol when $rd$ is present, entering $h_T$ if it is true and $h_F$ if it is false. When $rd$ is blank, it leaves the register unchanged, moves its head right, and enters $next$.
hypotheses_covered: optional bit read from the register
